reason: Timing off 'minutes after I put the phone down' instead of the clock is the first thing I've seen that fits a week where I sleep at 1am one night and 9am the next. The trial is free, doesn't auto-charge, and shows me my own numbers, so I'd try it. If the 14 days show a real gap I'd pay 4,900 for one month before I'd commit to the year.
objection: I've tried a bunch of sleep apps already and none of them stuck. Phone-movement sleep tracking sounds rough, so I'm not sure the 14-day comparison will actually be accurate, and when money's tight I cancel subscriptions first.
would_change_my_mind: If the day-14 comparison shows no real difference in how long it takes me to fall asleep, I'll stay on the free version, which the app says it will tell me anyway.
